role.both: strongest regular owner. Low for bounded or checkable semantic work; medium for exploratory or weakly checked work; high for demonstrated hard/deep work. Its low→medium gap is wide, so use low only with a strong checker.
role.single: strongest regular owner. Low for bounded or checkable semantic work; medium for exploratory or weakly checked work; high for demonstrated hard/deep work. Its low→medium gap is wide, so use low only with a strong checker.

role.both: behaves like a smaller model that scales well with effort while staying token- and time-efficient. Raise Sol effort freely: medium for Bounded work, high/xhigh for Standard work, max before Astra. Prefer raising Sol's effort over switching to a pricier model when Sol is suitable.
role.single: behaves like a smaller model that scales well with effort while staying token- and time-efficient. Raise Sol effort freely: medium for Bounded work, high/xhigh for Standard work, max before Astra. Prefer raising Sol's effort over switching to a pricier model when Sol is suitable.

role.both: very cheap and scales with effort, but time to first token rises sharply at high effort. Medium/high for small, well-specified implementation, deterministic verification, extraction and fixtures; xhigh/max as a fallback for Sol/Opus low–medium routes under allowance pressure. No judgment-heavy, ambiguous or consequential final calls.
role.single: very cheap and scales with effort, but time to first token rises sharply at high effort. Medium/high for small, well-specified implementation, deterministic verification, extraction and fixtures; xhigh/max as a fallback for Sol low–medium routes under allowance pressure. No judgment-heavy, ambiguous or consequential final calls.

role.both: hardest tasks only, when Opus high or Sol max demonstrably falls short. Opus 5.5 and Sol match it at lower cost almost everywhere else. Every Astra use needs a demonstrated hard need, capable regular routes that failed or are unsuitable, and explicit per-scope user approval. Low or medium, one bounded call at a time; never parallel or sustained, never xhigh/max/ultra.
role.single: hardest tasks only, when Sol max demonstrably falls short. Sol matches it at lower cost almost everywhere else. Every Astra use needs a demonstrated hard need, capable regular routes that failed or are unsuitable, and explicit per-scope user approval. Low or medium, one bounded call at a time; never parallel or sustained, never xhigh/max/ultra.

role.both: fallback only: low for mechanical work when the OpenAI allowance, and therefore Luna, is exhausted. Never a default.
role.single: fallback only: low for mechanical work with a direct checker when the Opus allowance is under pressure. Never a default.

evidence.note: [Artificial Analysis](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models) broad intelligence index / cost per task (a proxy for tokens, not a routing currency). Broad intelligence is not coding proof; on agentic coding the gap narrows.
